prompts.prompt: Some students have an interest or talent that is so meaningful they believe their application would be incomplete without it. If this sounds like you, then please share your story.

The lessons we take from obstacles we encounter can be fundamental to later success. Recount a time when you faced a challenge, setback, or failure. How did it affect you, and what did you learn from the experience?
Reflect on a time when you questioned or challenged a belief or idea. What prompted your thinking? What was the outcome?
Reflect on something that someone has done for you that has made you happy or thankful in a surprising way. How has this gratitude affected or motivated you?
Discuss an accomplishment, event, or realization that sparked a period of personal growth and a new understanding of yourself or others.
Describe a topic, idea, or concept you find so engaging that it makes you lose all track of time. Why does it captivate you? What or who do you turn to when you want to learn more?
Share an essay on any topic of your choice. It can be one you've already written, one that responds to a different prompt, or one of your own design.

intl_finance.document: Signed affidavit of support + supporting bank statement showing at least the first year's total expenses of attending MSU (uploaded in the admitted-student account, with a passport scan)

deadlines.label: Upload after paying the acceptance fee; MSU issues the I-20/DS-2019 only after the affidavit, bank statement and passport scan are reviewed
deadlines.note: No date published on this page

intl_finance.notes: Documents must be uploaded in the 'file upload' section of the account, not sent on paper (paper delays the I-20). The page does not give the dollar amount or a bank-statement issue-date window.

MSU Admissions: Obtain your immigration documents (international admits)

notes: MSU's application asks each applicant for one essay (minimum 250 words, maximum 650 words) chosen from seven prompts; this is the application essay itself, not a separate college-specific supplement, and the page lists no other written questions (the page lists checklist items; it does not explicitly say there is no supplement). The page introduces the prompts as 'the essay prompts for the 2026 application for admission' while the same page says the fall 2027 first-year application is open, so that the list is unchanged for fall 2027 entry is inferred from that. The 650 figure is the maximum; the minimum is 250. MSU accepts its own application, the Common App and the Coalition application; the page does not say which essay Common App or Coalition applicants submit. The current dollar amount for the bank statement and any statement-date window are not on the pages read (the OISS funding page was not read).
